faq.q: What is the origin of Aqilah?
faq.a: Aqilah is associated with Arabic. Feminine of عاقل ('wise, sensible').
Yes — the underlying form عاقلة is Arabic.
Aqilah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Aqilah, aqilah. Script forms are عاقلة, عاقله, عاقلہ, अक़ीला.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
